title: Zach Ertz "doing everything I can" to get back

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Zach Ertz "doing everything I can" to get back
sources.description: Zach Ertz said in April that he does not want last season's torn ACL to be the final act of his NFL career and said he has "eyes wide open" to the need to show he's healthy in order to find a place to play in 2026.
